{{short description|American mathematician}}
'''Thomas William Tucker''' (born July 15, 1945) is a retired<ref>[https://www.colgate.edu/academics/departments-programs/department-mathematics/faculty-and-staff Mathematics Faculty and Staff], retrieved 2026-06-03.</ref> American mathematician, a Charles Hetherington Professor of Mathematics,  Emeritus, at [[Colgate University]],<ref name="cv">[http://math.colgate.edu/faculty/tomtuck.html Faculty web page], retrieved 2014-10-29.</ref> and an expert in the area of [[topological graph theory]].<ref>J. L. Gross and T. W. Tucker, Topological Graph Theory, Wiley Interscience, 1987</ref><ref>{{cite journal|author=Thomassen, Carsten|title=Review: ''Topological Graph Theory'', by Jonathan L. Gross and Thomas W. Tucker|journal=Bull. Amer. Math. Soc. (N.S.)|year=1988|volume=19|issue=2|pages=560–561|url=http://www.ams.org/journals/bull/1988-19-02/S0273-0979-1988-15742-4/S0273-0979-1988-15742-4.pdf|doi=10.1090/s0273-0979-1988-15742-4|doi-access=free}}</ref>

Tucker did his undergraduate studies at [[Harvard University]], graduating in 1967,<ref name="cv"/> and obtained his Ph.D. from [[Dartmouth College]] in 1971, under the supervision of Edward Martin Brown.<ref>{{mathgenealogy|name=Thomas William Tucker|id=38735}}</ref>

Tucker's father, [[Albert W. Tucker]], was also a professional mathematician, and his brother, [[Alan Tucker]], and son, [[Thomas J. Tucker]], are also professional mathematicians.
